result.title: Validation-Gated ML Pipeline Synthesis with Expert-Grounded Self-Evolving Skills
result.summary: Recent advances in large language models have enabled agentic systems that automate machine learning pipeline construction from minimal user input. However, existing agentic AutoML methods either depend on rigid templates that limit adaptability, target narrow task domains, or rely on free-form code generation that lacks reliability guarantees, leaving intermediate errors to propagate silently and degrade the final model. We present EvoML, an agentic framework for end-to-end ML pipeline synthesis built on expert-grounded skills that evolve across runs, executed through a validation-gated harness. The framework decomposes pipeline construction into four phases coordinated by three agents: an Orchestrator that enforces validation gates, advancing each phase only when its outputs pass structural, execution, and semantic checks, which precludes error propagation and keeps every artifact auditable; an Executor that runs expert-grounded skills, grounded in the nnU-Net workflow and pairing reusable templates with online adaptation; and a Curator that performs post-run evolution, consolidating the scripts and guidance recovered during a run into the skill library so it improves across datasets. We evaluate EvoML on eight datasets spanning six sophisticated, real-world ML task types, against agentic AutoML systems and command-line coding tools. EvoML achieves full automation and the best final model quality on all eight, spanning segmentation (up to 0.94 Dice), classification (0.99 accuracy), reconstruction (0.95 SSIM), and denoising (0.79 normalized PSNR), while transferring to broader ML tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EvoML，一个端到端 ML pipeline 合成 agent 框架：由 Orchestrator 用结构、执行、语义校验门控四个阶段推进，Executor 运行基于 nnU-Net 的专家技能模板并在线适配，Curator 在运行后把脚本与指导沉淀进技能库，在八个数据集、六类任务上评估最终模型质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 「校验门控后才进入下一阶段」与运行后技能库整合，可能为 LVR 中基于证据充分性的继续/停止决策（LOOK/STOP）和跨样本经验复用提供一种流程化表述，但属间接启发，需核查其校验信号是否可迁移到推理状态。
